thread:
riley (docs): Heads-up: big-ish docs refactor landing next week. We're switching the reference docs to be OpenAPI-first and regenerating the SDK method surface. That means method names will change (eg `createCompletion` -> `generate_text`) to match the canonical operationId. Need cross-team alignment; this is technically breaking for anyone who depends on exact SDK method names. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2007

omar (sdk): TL;DR impact: SDKs will publish a compatibility minor that maps old method names to new names for two releases, but examples will show the new verbs. Clients that call methods by dynamic lookup (e.g., getattr in Python) may need updates.

jisoo (eng-runtime): Runtime unaffected functionally, but we'll add a response header `X-Method-Canonical: generate_text` for the next 60 days when old endpoints are used. No user-visible behavior change except name.

anya (product): This has exec visibility; exec-bot posted the FYI. We should coordinate Dedicated customer comms and call out why we changed it (consistency across SDKs + better OpenAPI alignment).

exec-bot: Exec note: engineering will present the change in next week's All-Hands; product to prepare a 2-slide FAQ.

harry (support): I'll draft KB and canned replies. Two asks: 1) list of top repos that import SDK methods dynamically, 2) a short repro for customers seeing AttributeError/NoMethod errors.

omar (sdk): Example old vs new for quickcopy (JS + Python):
```js
// OLD
await client.createCompletion({ model: 'redwood-7b', prompt: 'Hi' })
// NEW
await client.generate_text({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'Hi' })
```
```py
# OLD
res = client.createCompletion(model='redwood-7b', prompt='Hi')
# NEW
res = client.generate_text(model='redwood-7b', input='Hi')
```

riley (docs): Migration plan: 1) Add migration recipe with automated codemod examples (JS/Python/Go). 2) Banner on reference pages for 60 days. 3) SDK compat minor that logs a deprecation warning when old methods are used. 4) CI job to run codemod on our example apps to verify.

omar (sdk): We'll publish the compat minor alongside the docs flip. Compat shim will emit a runtime warning and map `createCompletion` -> `generate_text` for 2 releases, then remove. We'll open PRs to the SDK repos today.

jisoo (eng-runtime): We'll surface metrics for old-method usage and set an alert if usage doesn't drop after 30 days. Also adding `Deprecation-Warning` headers.

ci-bot: Docs preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/2007 (:eyes:)

deploy-bot: Canary flip scheduled: 2026-12-07 09:00 UTC (window 30m)

anya (product): Action items: 1) @riley publish the migration recipe and codemods 2) @omar SDK compat PRs + release notes 3) @harry KB + canned replies + top-account scan 4) @jisoo runtime headers + metrics alert 5) Product to draft Dedicated customer note. Please acknowledge and paste PR links in-thread.

harry (support): Ack  I'll start drafting KB and run a grep across our top customer automation repos for method name usage.

omar (sdk): Ack  PRs incoming, will attach snippet for codemod usage.

riley (docs): Thanks all. Keeping this thread as the source of truth. Ping me for blockers. :sparkles:
